renders.prompt: Explain the argument of this song as if to a bright 10-year-old. Short words. Concrete images. No jargon, no Sanskrit terms, no meta-commentary.

paragraphs.text: Bow to the god who gives freedom and every blessing. He is the sun that burned away the dark on every road. Praise the highest god — no set of beliefs owns him; you can only know him by feeling yourself, and he rests in himself. Bow to the lord who smashed the net of wrong ideas, standing past even the greatest joy.

His feet win: they teach the world to tell what matters from what does not, and wake the knowing that frees. Mind, thought, ego, breath, senses — all turn back when they see him, and we worship him. I bow to pure awareness, the only knife that cuts the knot of mine and I.
